Do the Best Work of Your Career

When we started Native, we believed cloud security was built backwards focusing on finding risk rather than preventing it. We started Native to change that by turning the security capabilities already built into the cloud into defenses that are actually enforced.

I’m fully aware this is a hard problem to solve. The technology keeps changing, every environment is different, and there’s no established playbook. But to be honest? That’s exactly why it's worth it and it’s why the people who thrive here chose to join.

We deliberately don't just follow the norm, building a new standard requires a culture of high standards and zero fluff. We move with urgency, speak plainly, and expect everyone to own the final outcome, not just their piece of it.

We rely on deep trust. From day one, you get real ownership to make critical decisions, challenge the work openly, and build what hasn’t been seen before.

If you want to tackle a hard problem with a team that’s all-in, you’ll fit right in. Let’s build something that lasts.

Co-Founder and CEO, Native

Why Join Team Native

We're doing the thing the whole industry decided was too hard. Turning the security already inside every cloud into defense that actually stops the breach. It's messy, unsolved, and the best work you'll do. Keep reading.

1

What is Native?

We're the Cloud Security Control Plane. We turn the security architecture already inside every cloud into active, enforced defense: guardrails that make bad outcomes structurally impossible. The industry got great at finding risk and slow at stopping it. We're changing that.

2

What's the culture like?

Exceptional team, high bar, real ownership. You’ll take complex problems from inception to launch, making critical decisions from day one. Our culture is built on blunt honesty, mutual accountability, and a shared responsibility to fix things when they break. We operate with low hierarchy, high trust, dynamic environment and we run fast.

3

Why choose Native?

You'll work on a problem no one has solved yet, alongside people who've built cloud and infrastructure security from the inside. The product is genuinely good, the market is wide open, and your work ships into real enterprise clouds fast. If you've got the talent and the drive, this is where you'll do the best work of your career.

4

What are the perks?

The things that actually make a day good: great people, an office you'll want to be in, lunches worth showing up for, and real benefits. Plus a product you'll be proud to put your name on.
